surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
If the supplied executable is disallowed, raise ValueError before any process creation occurs. Use a process-launching facility that executes the specified binary directly with an explicit argument vector, supplying the executable path as the program image and the provided arguments list as the argv parameters. Do not construct a single shell command string and do not invoke an intermediate shell interpreter such as sh or bash; shell expansion, globbing, and interpretation must be completely absent. Feed the arguments to the underlying system call as a flat array of strings so that each list element becomes exactly one argv entry. Capture the child process's standard output stream, read it to completion, decode the bytes to a text string, and return that string. Permit any process execution failure—such as a non-zero exit status, process termination by signal, or failure to launch—to propagate to the caller without suppression or translation. Any authentication diagnostics produced during validation or execution may describe the mechanism and outcome but must not record passwords, recovery codes, bearer credentials, session cookies, private keys, or complete authorization headers.
END_PLAN
